title: exotic portuguese chicken papillote
description: a spicy, tender portuguese dish showcasing the combination of apricot jam, papillote, and kosher-friendly ingredients.
instructions: season the chicken breasts with kosher salt and black pepper
heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sear the chicken breasts until browned
transfer the chicken breasts to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and set aside
add the rosemary sprigs, garlic cloves, chicken broth, and white wine to the skillet and bring to a simmer
reduce the heat to medium-low and let cook for 5 minutes
spread a layer of apricot jam on each chicken breast
place the chicken breasts in the papillote and tie with kitchen twine
place the papillote on the baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes
remove the papillote from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving
